profile.headline: Software Engineer II

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant - Data Structures and Algorithms
positions.description:
- Led weekly 1 hour discussion section covering concepts including C++ programming, Big O notation, data structures including lists, stacks, queues, trees, sets, maps, and graphs, and related algorithms.
- Advised students 4 hours per week through office hours and course Slack on assignments and course material.
- Graded over 30 students' assignments for 4 hours a week.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
- Created and presented demo to leadership of internally developed sensor to help acquire future contracts.
- Developed sensor in Agile team using C++ with internal libraries, debuggers, and testing tools.
- Coordinated creation of deployment tool to better automate delivery of builds to customers.

positions.title: Undergraduate Teaching Assistant - Programming Fundamentals 1
positions.description:
- Led weekly 2-hour discussion section reviewing introductory Java programming material and assisting students with their lab assignments.
- Held office hours 2 hours per week.
- Graded over 20 students' labs, projects, and exams on Canvas.
- Answered student questions and concerns in course Slack.

projects.title: Senior Project - Guppie Grader
projects.description: Guppie Grader was a web application developed to help UF DSA teaching assistants grade faster by processing student code and documentation using ChatGPT-4.0 and LLM training techniques. Guppie Grader used a Next.js frontend and Python backend to provide automated feedback that teaching assistants could use to help grade student's projects. I served as the group's Scrum Master, keeping us organized through Discord events, scheduling of weekly meetings, and a Asana board for tasking.
